description:
Record money received against threads, and produce billed-versus-received statements.

Subcommands:
  log THREAD AMOUNT [-c CURRENCY] [-d DATE] [-t HH:MM] [-a ACCOUNT] [-n NOTE] — record a receipt
  list [THREAD] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json] — list payments
  statement [--thread T] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json] [--as-of DATE] [--pdf PATH] — billed vs received by thread and currency
  show ID [--json] — show one payment
  edit ID [--amount AMOUNT] [-c CURRENCY] [-d DATE] [-t HH:MM] [-a ACCOUNT] [-n NOTE] — change one field of a payment
  rm ID -y — delete a payment

Args:
  THREAD  a name, 'Kind/Name' or a wikilink
  AMOUNT  a positive decimal; required
  ID  the payment's 8-char id from list

Flags:
  log: -c/--currency is an ISO code; defaults to the thread's currency. Pass it if the thread has none. -d/--date is the date received, YYYY-MM-DD (default today). -t/--time is HH:MM (default now). -a/--account is the account the money landed in. -n/--note is free text.
  list: --since and --until take YYYY-MM-DD. --json gives JSON output.
  statement: --as-of DATE is the statement date and drives aging (default today). --pdf PATH renders a PDF to PATH and requires --thread.
  edit: --amount, -c, -d, -t, -a and -n set new values.
  rm: -y (or --yes) is required.

Examples:
  ["log", "Projects/SGB", "15000.00", "-c", "ZAR", "-d", "2026-09-25", "-a", "Business cheque"]
  ["statement", "--thread", "Projects/SGB", "--json"]
  ["statement", "--thread", "Projects/SGB", "--pdf", "sgb-statement.pdf"]
  ["edit", "abcd1234", "--amount", "14500"]

Notes:
  -n takes several words, so put it last, after the positionals and the other flags.
  log also queues a REF in the buffer under the date received. It reaches the daily log on the next buffer flush.
  log, edit and rm rewrite the thread's payments file. rm is permanent.
  Exit 1: amount missing, not positive or not valid; --pdf without --thread; nothing to state for the thread.

BLOCKED: rm. These subcommands are refused and calling one returns an error. Do not attempt them.
